label: pase_leading_zero_w0_pbkdf
description: matter.js PasePairingTest.ts:56-61 — PBKDF2 derivation where the resulting w0 has a leading zero byte. Regression test for an elliptic-library bug that produced wrong verifier values when w0 started with 0x00. passcode=20202021, iterations=1000. Note: matter.js emits w0.toString(16) which strips the leading zero byte producing a 63-nibble string; the canonical 32-byte big-endian encoding used here is '00177867...' (64 nibbles).
